purpose: Teach: 管内/称号/単調/対称/要綱/パイオニア/訳注/経団連

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、管内の支店を巡回しろ
lines.en: Tour the branches across our company territory.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Even delivery without warmth. Expectation of compliance. No room for negotiation — this is instruction, not invitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。優秀社員に新称号を付与する制度を作ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll create a system to award new titles to our top performers.
lines.style: Measured, professional response. Slight lift of confidence on the solution. Processing and executing without hesitation. Respectful but assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、単調なルーチンを見直せ
lines.en: Review our company's monotonous routines. Fix them.
lines.style: Direct, cutting through excess. No softening. The tone of someone used to having his orders followed. Minimal pause between statements.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織図を左右対称に整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll restructure the organizational chart for symmetry.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgement. Practical, unadorned. Already moving to the next task. No elaboration — just confirmation and the plan.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Mandate delivered flatly. Brief, final-sounding. The weight of authority without inflection. This is not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社は業界のパイオニアです
lines.en: Understood. Our company is an industry pioneer.
lines.style: Pride entering the voice here — subtle but present. Emphasis on 'pioneer' with quiet confidence. Kenji allowing himself a moment of genuine pride in the company.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、英文資料には訳注を付けろ
lines.en: Add translator's notes to all our English-language documents.
lines.style: Precise instruction. Specificity on the details. The discipline of his usual tone. Expects this will be done without question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経団連の動向を注視します
lines.en: Understood. I'll monitor developments at the Keidanren closely.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Closing the conversation with finality. Steady, assured. The last word — shows he understands the weight of what's been asked.
